component.name: Faster-Godot
component.summary: Performance-first Godot-based desktop game engine fork with a feature-rich editor

description.p: Faster-Godot is an independent fork based on Godot Engine. It narrows the runtime profile around Windows and Linux x86_64 Forward+ Vulkan games.

Faster-Godot is not part of, affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by the Godot Engine project, the godotengine GitHub organization, or the Godot Foundation. It is provided as-is under MIT/Expat license terms.
